get.description: Changes whenever a task is added, edited or deleted, so a client can skip downloading an unchanged list.

schema.title: Response Tasks Api V1 Tasks Get

patch.description:
Apply one change to up to 100 tasks, as selecting several tasks in the apps does: complete or reopen,
date, priority, project, space or labels. Each task needs the version from your last read and is changed on
its own, exactly like PATCH /tasks/{id}. The response lists each outcome; a 409 for one task leaves the
others changed.

post.description: Notify every enabled device again at a later time. Works from a notification without the task's version.

Permanently delete up to 100 tasks, each with the version from your last read. Each is deleted on its own,
exactly like DELETE /tasks/{id}, and the response lists each outcome.

schema.title: Response Tokens Api V1 Tokens Get
Response Sessions Api V1 Sessions Get

get.description: A summary of one task or project, for link previews and fallbacks.

The shared search contract (docs/search.md): tasks by title, description, checklist and labels;
projects by name.

Tasks and projects that point at the target: a stored link (POST /tasks/{id}/links), or a task
description that links to or embeds it ([[type:id]], ![[type:id]] or the full ref).
The count on the companion's collapsed strip: open tasks due today or overdue, in each task's zone.
Server-sent events { ref, kind: updated|deleted, version } for this user's tasks and projects.

LinkIn.title: LinkIn

SnoozeIn.title: SnoozeIn
SnoozeIn.description: Remind again after a number of minutes, or at a given time. At most 7 days ahead.

TaskOut.title: TaskOut
